title: Loose material on walking-working surface
location: Floor area between the blue press and the marked aisle
observation: A loose circular metal object is resting on the floor in an open area adjacent to the marked aisle. The object is not contained within a designated storage zone and is situated on the walking-working surface.
risk_interpretation: Loose material left on a walking surface outside a marked storage area is a trip hazard under 1910.22(a)(3).
recommended_actions: Relocate the loose object to a designated storage area.; Ensure all raw materials are stored in marked zones to keep walking surfaces clear.
